title: 2D transform matrix utilities
description: Pure 2D matrix math helpers in packages/core/src/engine/matrix.ts: Matrix2D type (a,b,c,d,tx,ty), identity(), translate(), scale(), rotate(), skew(), multiply(a,b), inverse(m), applyToPoint(m, p), applyToRect(m, r), decompose(m) → {tx,ty,scaleX,scaleY,rotation,skewX,skewY}, compose({tx,ty,scaleX,scaleY,rotation}) → Matrix2D. Used by Free Transform tool and SWF MATRIX encoder. Export from engine/index.ts. No UI.
